current_priorities: Run a five-session dogfood ledger: clean-install first edit, ordinary project work, restricted startup, forced-interruption recovery, and one session by a non-author of the subsystem.
From those transcripts, ship no more than three product corrections, beginning with the smallest shared-model first-run/help improvement that materially reduces confusion.
Execute the tag/manual hosted exact-byte lane, retain and download its subjects, and verify repository, workflow, ref, commit, signer identity, and subject digests from a consumer context.
Choose one coordinator extraction only when it has a second real consumer, narrows authority, preserves journeys, and deletes more `Editor` responsibility than it adds.

Define a compact versioned extension “world,” grapheme/terminal-cell policy, filesystem/power-loss matrix, package/API/revision version relationship, and distinct public name only from concrete consumers and executed evidence.
